text:
By Source Staff ,
10 hours ago At 12:51 PM in Maury County, the current temperature is 86.7°F with a wind speed of 12.3 mph. Conditions are mainly clear, and there has been no recorded precipitation.
For the rest of the day, the high is expected to reach 90.3°F, while the low tonight will be around 76.6°F. Winds may increase slightly, reaching up to 13.2 mph during the day and calming to 8.1 mph this evening. The chance of precipitation remains at 0%, and conditions are expected to become overcast overnight.
No official weather warnings are currently in effect for Maury County. Conditions are stable, with no significant weather events anticipated for the remainder of the day.
